note: PSoXide Demo Disc v0.44, public pressing, all XA: no CD-DA track. Celeste is 0.2.7 (main 1fb78a8 code with the brightness stepper, palette fix and card-save repin); NitroXide (SDK pad engine, background settings save), VoXide 0.4.1 and Quake (integ/quake-2026-10-16) are the library installs of 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16; Arcade and Cortex (Graybox Reach) keep the XA builds of the v0.44-test pressing; PSXcel is the v0.43 bare EXE, byte for byte. Launcher menu music is XA (Mulula VGM Loops, CC BY 4.0). Public pressing only: Half-Life, Hollow Knight, WipEout, Counter-Strike and the hardware tests are never on it, and a public file is checked for that (disc-tools public-only). The local fields name checkouts on the build machine that hold each revision. Hashes gate every input; disc-tools lineup refuses a file that changed.
